title: Country Climate and Development Report: Western Balkans 6. North Macedonia Country Compendium
temporal_coverage: October 2024 compendium; municipal vulnerability inputs include 2021 census and 2020 market-access data, with climate and economic projections to 2050.
methodology: CCDR with climate-risk modeling, sector analysis and municipal hazard/vulnerability mapping.
limitations: Municipal inputs are dated; impact modeling has significant uncertainty.

title: North Macedonia Common Country Analysis for the 2021–2025 United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework
organization: United Nations Country Team in North Macedonia
temporal_coverage: CCA issued November 2020; analysis was conducted mainly November 2019–March 2020 and predates full COVID-19 assessment.
methodology: UN country analysis using document review, interviews and participatory risk analysis.
limitations: Mostly pre-COVID-19; dated national assessment, not a current local baseline.

title: The Municipalities of the Republic of North Macedonia take steps to enter the 2030s with greater resilience
organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction, Regional Office for Europe and Central Asia
temporal_coverage: Reports UNDRR cooperation and municipal resilience scorecards conducted in 2024.
methodology: UNDRR report on city cooperation, scorecard workshops and disaster-resilience planning.
limitations: Article summarizes the exercise; it publishes no municipality-level scores or measured outcome changes.
